findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT logs list 12 unique hostnames with 1 risky hostname: staging.copperline.example, pattern staging, first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly logged staging hostname may expose a less-hardened environment or test data for this supply-chain SaaS, increasing attack-surface and diligence follow-up risk; validate reachability and segmentation pre-close.

remediation.summary: Verify staging.copperline.example is not publicly reachable, enforce authentication/VPN, remove sensitive data, and restrict future certificate exposure.
